list-pdf-form-field-names.title: List PDF Form Field Names with Aspose.Pdf
list-pdf-form-field-names.description: Shows how to load a PDF, access its AcroForm fields via the Form collection, and output each field's PartialName to the console.

add-text-field-to-pdf.title: Add Text Field to PDF Using Aspose.Pdf
add-text-field-to-pdf.description: Demonstrates how to create and place a text box form field at specific coordinates in a PDF document and save the updated file.

fill-textbox-field-in-pdf.title: Fill TextBox Field in PDF using Aspose.Pdf Form
fill-textbox-field-in-pdf.description: Demonstrates how to load an existing PDF, fill a specific AcroForm textbox field with a string value, and save the updated document using the Aspose.Pdf Facades API.

justify-text-in-pdf-form-textbox.title: Justify Text in a Filled PDF TextBox Using FormEditor
justify-text-in-pdf-form-textbox.description: Demonstrates how to fill a PDF textbox field and then apply justified alignment to its content by configuring a FormFieldFacade and calling FormEditor.DecorateField.

retrieve-radio-button-option-values.title: Retrieve Radio Button Option Values into Hashtable
retrieve-radio-button-option-values.description: Demonstrates how to use Aspose.Pdf.Facades.Form to obtain all export values of a radio button group and store them in a Hashtable for further processing.

get-selected-radio-button-value.title: Get Selected Radio Button Value from PDF Form
get-selected-radio-button-value.description: Demonstrates how to load a PDF document with Aspose.Pdf.Facades, bind it to a Form object, and retrieve the currently selected option of a radio button group using GetButtonOptionCurrentValue.

export-pdf-form-data-to-xml.title: Export PDF Form Data to JSON
export-pdf-form-data-to-xml.description: Loads a PDF document, enables automatic form field recalculation, and exports all form field values to a JSON file using Aspose.Pdf.

export-pdf-form-data-to-fdf.title: Export PDF Form Data to FDF File
export-pdf-form-data-to-fdf.description: Shows how to load a PDF, bind it to the Form facade, and export its AcroForm data to an FDF file using a file stream.

export-pdf-form-fields-to-xfdf.title: Export PDF Form Data to XFDF
export-pdf-form-fields-to-xfdf.description: Demonstrates loading a PDF, binding it to the Form facade, and exporting its AcroForm fields to an XFDF file on disk.

export-pdf-form-fields-to-json.title: Export PDF Form Fields to JSON and Verify Structure
export-pdf-form-fields-to-json.description: Demonstrates how to export AcroForm field names and values from a PDF into a JSON file using Aspose.Pdf, then reads and validates the JSON structure.

import-form-fields-from-xml.title: Import XML Data into PDF Form Fields
import-form-fields-from-xml.description: Demonstrates how to bind a PDF form and import field values from an XML file using the Form facade's ImportXml method, then save the filled PDF.

import-fdf-data-into-pdf-form.title: Import Form Data from FDF into PDF
import-fdf-data-into-pdf-form.description: Shows how to load a PDF, open an FDF file as a stream, import the form data using the Form facade, and save the updated PDF.

import-xfdf-data-into-pdf-form.title: Import XFDF Form Data into a PDF
import-xfdf-data-into-pdf-form.description: Demonstrates how to bind an existing PDF, import form field values from an XFDF file using the Form facade, and save the updated document.

import-json-data-into-pdf-form.title: Import FDF Data into PDF Form with Missing Field Handling
import-json-data-into-pdf-form.description: Demonstrates how to import FDF data into an AcroForm PDF using Aspose.Pdf.Facades.Form and handle missing form fields by catching the exception and logging the field name.

batch-export-pdf-form-data-to-xml.title: Batch Export PDF Form Data to XML (XFDF)
batch-export-pdf-form-data-to-xml.description: Shows how to iterate over multiple PDF files, load each with Aspose.Pdf, and export its AcroForm data to an XFDF XML file using the Form facade.

batch-import-json-data-into-pdfs.title: Batch Import JSON Data into PDF Forms in Parallel
batch-import-json-data-into-pdfs.description: Demonstrates how to import form field values from matching JSON files into multiple PDF documents simultaneously using Aspose.Pdf's Form facade and parallel processing.

combine-acroform-json-exports.title: Combine PDF Text Exports into a Single JSON Array
combine-acroform-json-exports.description: Extracts text from multiple PDF files using Aspose.Pdf, creates a JSON object for each file, and writes a combined JSON array to an output file.

export-pdf-form-data-to-xml-memorystream.title: Export PDF Form Data to JSON via Memory Stream
export-pdf-form-data-to-xml-memorystream.description: Loads a PDF into a MemoryStream, creates an Aspose.Pdf Document, and exports the AcroForm fields to JSON (which can be transformed to XML) without creating intermediate files on disk.

merge-acroform-data-into-json.title: Merge AcroForm Data from Multiple PDFs into JSON
merge-acroform-data-into-json.description: Loads several PDF files, extracts each document's AcroForm field names and values, aggregates the data into a list of dictionaries, and writes the combined result to a formatted JSON file.

export-filter-pdf-form-fields-xfdf.title: Export PDF Form Fields Starting with "Customer" to XML
export-filter-pdf-form-fields-xfdf.description: Loads a PDF document, filters AcroForm fields whose names begin with "Customer", and writes those field names and values to an XML file.

export-selected-acroform-fields-to-json.title: Export Selected AcroForm Fields to JSON
export-selected-acroform-fields-to-json.description: Shows how to load a PDF, pick specific form fields by name, and serialize their values into a JSON file.

import-form-data-from-json.title: Import JSON Data into PDF Form While Ignoring Missing Fields
import-form-data-from-json.description: Demonstrates how to load JSON data from a file and import it into an AcroForm PDF using Aspose.Pdf.Facades.Form, automatically skipping any fields that are not present in the PDF.

validate-xml-import-into-pdf-form.title: Validate XML with XSD and Import into PDF Form
validate-xml-import-into-pdf-form.description: Shows how to validate an XML file against an XSD schema and, after successful validation, import the XML data into an AcroForm PDF using Aspose.Pdf.Facades.

export-import-pdf-form-fields-utf8.title: Export and Import Unicode Form Field Values with UTF-8
export-import-pdf-form-fields-utf8.description: Demonstrates how to set Unicode text in an AcroForm field, export the data to an UTF‑8 encoded XFDF stream, and import it back before saving the PDF.

list-pdf-form-fields-to-csv.title: List PDF Form Fields and Export to CSV
list-pdf-form-fields-to-csv.description: Shows how to load a PDF, read its AcroForm fields using Aspose.Pdf, and write each field's name and type to a CSV report.

export-text-acroform-field-names-to-json.title: Export Text Form Field Names from PDF to JSON
export-text-acroform-field-names-to-json.description: Loads a PDF document, extracts the names of all text box AcroForm fields, and writes the list to a formatted JSON file.

add-radio-button-group-to-pdf.title: Add Radio Button Group with Default Selection to PDF
add-radio-button-group-to-pdf.description: Shows how to insert a radio button group with three options into an existing PDF and programmatically set the default selected option using Aspose.Pdf FormEditor.

validate-radio-button-options.title: Verify Radio Button Options in PDF Form
validate-radio-button-options.description: Shows how to bind a PDF, retrieve the options of a radio‑button field using Aspose.Pdf, and compare them with an expected set to validate form integrity.

export-import-acroform-xfdf.title: Export and Import AcroForm Data via XFDF
export-import-acroform-xfdf.description: Demonstrates exporting form field values to an XFDF file and importing them back into a fresh PDF to verify that the round‑trip preserves all field data.

fill-pdf-form-fields-from-json.title: Fill PDF Form Fields from JSON
fill-pdf-form-fields-from-json.description: Loads a PDF template containing AcroForm fields, reads a JSON file of key/value pairs, maps each JSON property to a matching form field, sets the field value, and saves the populated PDF.

update-pdf-acroform-fields-from-byte-arr.title: Update PDF Form Fields from Byte Array
update-pdf-acroform-fields-from-byte-arr.description: Demonstrates loading a PDF from a byte array using MemoryStream, modifying AcroForm fields, and returning the updated PDF as a byte array.

extract-pdf-form-field-names.title: List PDF Form Field Names as JSON
extract-pdf-form-field-names.description: Demonstrates how to load a PDF using Aspose.Pdf.Facades, retrieve all AcroForm field names, and output them in formatted JSON.

fill-pdf-acroform-fields.title: Fill PDF Form Fields with Aspose.Pdf.Facades
fill-pdf-acroform-fields.description: Shows how to bind a PDF, set AcroForm field values using FormFiller, and save the updated document.

export-pdf-form-data-to-json.title: Export PDF AcroForm Data to JSON and Deserialize to Typed Object
export-pdf-form-data-to-json.description: Demonstrates extracting AcroForm field values from a PDF, writing them to a JSON file, and deserializing the JSON into a strongly‑typed C# class using Json.NET.

import-json-data-into-pdf-acroform.title: Import JSON Data into PDF Form using Aspose.Pdf Facade
import-json-data-into-pdf-acroform.description: Shows how to serialize a C# object to JSON, wrap it in a MemoryStream, import the JSON into an AcroForm with Aspose.Pdf.Facades.Form, and save the updated PDF.

export-pdf-form-data-to-json-chunks.title: Export PDF Form Data to JSON with Batch Splitting
export-pdf-form-data-to-json-chunks.description: Shows how to read AcroForm fields from a PDF using Aspose.Pdf, serialize the field names and values to JSON, and split the result into separate files containing no more than 100 fields each.

export-pdf-form-to-xml-html.title: Export PDF Form Data to XML and Transform to HTML
export-pdf-form-to-xml-html.description: Shows how to extract AcroForm data from a PDF into an XML file using Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfFormEditor, then convert that XML to an HTML view with an XSLT stylesheet.

import-xml-into-pdf-form-validate-requir.title: Import XML Data into AcroForm and Validate Required Fields
import-xml-into-pdf-form-validate-requir.description: Demonstrates how to import form data from an XML file into a PDF AcroForm using Aspose.Pdf, then checks required fields for empty values and logs any violations before saving the updated PDF.

async-export-pdf-form-data-to-xml.title: Asynchronously Export PDF Form Data to XML
async-export-pdf-form-data-to-xml.description: Demonstrates using Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfFormEditor to bind a PDF and export its form fields to an XML file without blocking the UI thread by wrapping the operation in Task.Run and awaiting it.

create-pdf-form-fields-report.title: Generate PDF Report of AcroForm Fields
create-pdf-form-fields-report.description: Creates a PDF document that lists each form field's name, type, and value by iterating over Document.Form.Fields and rendering the data in a table.
